title: Google Chrome Speed Tests
summary: Google's 2010 Chrome ad filmed web page rendering with a high-speed camera, comparing it with a potato gun, a pirate ship and lightning. It presented browser speed as Chrome's key selling point.
why: HN cites it as an example of Chrome's speed-focused marketing and of how fast Chrome seemed at launch compared with other browsers.

quote.text: Chrome was seriously fast when it launched. It made everything else seem a decade old.
